Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the inference latency and the deployment flexibility you showed. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture of the commercial construct for an on-prem / VPC deployment so I can present options to our CFO. A few specific questions: 

- Can you show examples of how the platform fee is typically amortized across a 2- vs 3-year term?
- Do you support an operator-seat model (per SRE) vs site license? If so, what are the typical breakpoints for discounts?
- How do support tiers map to response SLAs and on-call retainer fees? We need to understand outage credit mechanics.

Our budget for Y1 implementation + first-year support is constrained — roughly $600k — but we can be flexible if there are staggered payment structures or credits for pilot-to-prod conversion.

Could you send a short term-sheet or sketch with a couple of packaging options and a sample SOW so we can run this by finance? If easier, we can do a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,

Claire — really appreciate the clear ask. Short version up front: yes, we can support both operator-seat and site-anchored licensing; platform fee amortization and a pilot credit are typical ways we bridge budget timing. I attached a slim term sheet and a starter SOW draft for HelixCare so you have concrete numbers.

Key options (summary):

1) Site Anchor (recommended for multisite installs)
- Annual platform fee (covers control plane + observability): $300k/year
- Operator licenses: optional, $3.5k/operator/month if you want per-SRE metering
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5, 24-hour response), Premier (24x7, 4-hour response)
- Pilot credit: first 3 months of platform fee credited if you convert to a 2-year committed deployment

2) Operator-seat First (recommended for single-site early adopters)
- Lower up-front platform fee: $120k first year
- Operator licenses required for production seats; volume discounts at 10/25/50 seats
- On-call retainer: $45k/year for 24x7 priority oncall (applies to Premier)

Support / SLA:
- Premier: 4-hour P1 response, 8-hour remediation target; includes designated SRE escalation contact and quarterly reliability reviews.
- Service credits available for missed SLA windows (sliding scale: 5% credit for single P1 miss, up to 25% for repeated breaches over quarter)

I propose a call with Soojin (support lead) and Marissa (commercial ops) to walk through: 1) how credits would be applied and 2) how we could structure a phased invoice schedule to hit your $600k Y1 target. Available slots: Tue 3–5pm PT, Wed 9–11am PT.

PFA: helixcare_term_sheet_v1.pdf (PDF), helixcare_sow_draft.docx (DOCX)

Best,

Hi Claire — looping in with the SLA appendix and explicit credit table as requested. Key clarifications inline: 

- Credit mechanics: credits are applied to the next invoice following validation. Table below (applies per quarter):
  * 1 P1 incident (validated): 5% credit on quarterly platform fee
  * 2 P1 incidents: 12% credit on quarterly platform fee
  * 3+ P1 incidents: 25% credit on quarterly platform fee (cap of 25%)
  * Credit does not apply to professional services line items or operator-license fees

- Pilot credit flexibility: we can support your request to pay 50% upfront and receive the remaining pilot credit on formal conversion (rather than waiting three months). We will reflect that as an option in the term sheet: "Pilot prepay at 50% with conversion credit applied to Year 1 platform fee".

- Operator seat discounts (bands):
  * 1–4 seats: list price
  * 5–14 seats: 10% off list
  * 15–39 seats: 18% off list
  * 40+ seats: 28% off list

I'll attach a one-page SLA appendix and a short example amortization schedule (24 months) for the site-anchor path. Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm whether we want a hard cap on total quarterly credits (some customers ask for a 50% annual cap) or leave the cap at the per-incident structure above?

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
